source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 47(1) (subst. by Mah. Act 20 of 2015 s.20(24))
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 47 (both columns): '(1) Instrument of any partnership INCLUSIVE OF Limited Liability Partnership and Joint Venture to run a business, earn profits and to share — (a) where there is no share of contribution in partnership, or where such share contribution brought in by way of cash does not exceed rupees 50,000 — Five hundred rupees; (b) where such share contribution brought in by way of cash is in excess of rupees 50,000 or part thereof — One per cent of the amount of share contribution subject to maximum of rupees fifteen thousand. (2) Dissolution of partnership or retirement of partner ... (b) in any other case — Five hundred rupees.'

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official IGR). Historical 2015-04-24 through 2024-10-13 constitution rate: cash share_contribution ≤ Rs 50,000 (or none) → Rs 500; above → 1% of contribution, cap Rs 15,000. Art 47 expressly includes LLP and Joint Venture.

source.ref: Maharashtra Act IX of 2025, ss.1(2), 2(11), p.3
source.quoted_text: Section 1(2) deems the Act in force on 14 October 2024. Section 2(11): in Schedule I, in article 47, in clause (1), in sub-clause (b), for the words 'fifteen thousand' the words 'fifty thousand' shall be substituted.

notes_for_reviewer: From 14 October 2024 the Article 47(1)(b) ceiling is Rs 50,000; the Rs 50,000 contribution threshold and 1% rate are unchanged.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (statute expressly includes LLP). Historical cross-reference through 2024-10-13: contribution ≤ Rs 50k → Rs 500; else 1% cap Rs 15,000.
